states.claim: profile points to the image's EXIF StringInfo profile, or is NULL if no EXIF profile exists.
exif points to the byte storage region of the EXIF profile data.
directory is initialized to point into the exif storage region at the first IFD offset.
directory_stack entries store directory pointers, entry indices, and tag offsets for nested IFD traversal.
directory is restored from directory_stack when a nested IFD level is popped.
q points to the current 12-byte directory entry within the directory storage region.
p points to the inline value bytes within the directory entry when the value fits in 4 bytes.
p points into the exif storage region at the directory entry's offset when the value does not fit inline.
p1 is initialized from p and advanced by size per component while formatting multiple EXIF values.
value is allocated as a new string holding the formatted EXIF tag value, or remains NULL if allocation fails.

states.claim: value is released after being used to set the image property.
key is allocated as a copy of the property string and released after use.
exif_resources is a newly created splay tree used to track visited directory entries, and is destroyed before return.
q is recorded in exif_resources to detect duplicate directory entries.

values.claim: tag_bytes[] = {0,1,1,2,4,8,1,1,2,4,8,4,8}; number_bytes = components * tag_bytes[format], with format validated < 12 and != 0, and components >= 0.
Overflow guard: if number_bytes < components, break; number_bytes is the byte count derived from components.
If number_bytes <= 4, p = q+8 (inline value); otherwise p is set from an offset into exif.
dir_offset must be >= 0 and < length; (size_t)dir_offset + number_bytes must not overflow and must be <= length before p = exif+dir_offset.
q = directory + 12*entry + 2; q must be <= exif+length-12.
values.evidence:
L609: q=(unsigned char *) (directory+(12*entry)+2);
L610: if (q > (exif+length-12))

values.claim: Before formatting, p must satisfy p >= exif and p <= exif+length-tag_bytes[format].
values.evidence: L652: if ((p < exif) || (p > (exif+length-tag_bytes[format])))

values.claim: For EXIF_FMT_STRING/default, p must satisfy p >= exif and p <= exif+length-number_bytes.

String/default loop writes value[i] for i in [0, number_bytes) and then value[number_bytes]='\0'; p[i] is read in the same range.

values.claim: For '#'/'@' tag spec, n = strlen(property) must equal 4; n/=4; tag is built by shifting left 4 and OR-ing hex digit values.

length = GetStringInfoLength(profile); if length < 6 return; after EXIF header scan, if length < 16 return.

values.claim: id = ReadPropertySignedShort(LSBEndian, exif); endian is LSBEndian if id==0x4949, MSBEndian if id==0x4D4D, else return.
For all==2, key formatting uses tag_value: '#%04lx' if tag_value < 0x10000, '@%04lx' with (tag_value & 0xffff) if tag_value < 0x20000, else 'unknown'.
